description: This file defines the EmployeeListAPI class, which provides a REST API endpoint to list employees available for interviewing within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for handling GET requests, retrieving employee data with filtering and pagination, and validation rules for request parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeListAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for listing employees available for interviewing. Implements GET method with filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list employees, applying filters and returning a collection result with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for GET parameters such as 'nameOrId' and sorting options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws an exception as creation of employee list is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws an exception as creation validation rules are not applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws an exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws an exception as delete validation rules are not applicable.
